var ready bool
ready = count > 0

cards.title: Classify a response status
cards.code:
switch status {
case 200, 201:
    fmt.Println("success")
case 404:
    fmt.Println("missing")
default:
    fmt.Println("unexpected")
}
cards.explanation: Choose a matching case by value or by Boolean condition.
